A ''C-One'' liner with eighteen passengers in first class, enjoying the finest hospitality that Salin Excursions has to offer.|[[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], on the ''Salin Mariner''|<ref name="Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>}}
'''Salin Excursions''' was a business that operated the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], providing exuberant cruises between the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]] and [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]].
